prompt_template: The workspace contains dedupe.py with a failing test suite in tests/. The function unique_preserve_order must return the items with duplicates removed while preserving first-seen order (the {{case_name}} cases use {{input_type}}). Fix dedupe.py only; do not modify the tests. When the suite passes, write summary.md describing the bug and the fix, then deliver summary.md.

anchors.0: Suite still failing or function removed.
anchors.20: Some tests pass; behavior still wrong on ordering.
anchors.40: Full suite passes with order preserved on every case.

anchors.0: No summary or suite not run.
anchors.15: Fix works but summary thin or missing a required element.
anchors.25: Suite green and summary explains bug and fix.

anchors.0: First test failure ends useful work.
anchors.10: Reads the failure, diagnoses the ordering bug, verifies the fix.
Only dedupe.py changed; summary.md delivered as instructed.
